photos.desc: Species: Microglossum viride Not a very common species and usually found growing from the ground but in this case it was found on well decayed wood. Common name: Yellow Earth Tongue Found: Native fore
For more information about this, see the observation page at Mushroom Observer.
Microglossum viride from the Soquel Demonstration Forest. January, 2015.
